sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Choose the right participle by voice and tense, then pick between close pairs
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильное причастие по залогу и времени, затем выберите из близких пар

items.prompt: Статья, _____ известным учёным, вызвала дискуссию. (written by a famous scientist)
items.promptEnglish: The article written by a famous scientist sparked a debate.
items.hint: The article was written (passive, completed action).
items.explanation: Passive past participle написанная: the article was written by someone (completed action, passive voice). Написавшая would mean 'the article that wrote' (active, nonsensical).

items.prompt: Текст, _____ редактором, будет опубликован завтра. (being reviewed right now)
items.promptEnglish: The text being reviewed by the editor will be published tomorrow.
items.hint: Ongoing passive action = passive present participle (-емый).
items.explanation: Passive present проверяемый: the text is currently being reviewed (ongoing passive). Проверенный would mean already reviewed (completed).

items.prompt: Which sentence is INCORRECT in formal written Russian?
options: Мы видели девушку, которая поющая песню.
Построенный в прошлом веке дом стоит до сих пор.
items.answer: Мы видели девушку, которая поющая песню.
items.hint: You cannot combine который with a participle form.
items.explanation: Который + participle is a common error. Use either: девушку, поющую песню (participle only) OR девушку, которая поёт песню (который + finite verb).

items.prompt: Мы подошли к зданию, _____ в XIX веке. (built in the 19th century)
items.promptEnglish: We approached the building built in the 19th century.
items.hint: К + dative. The building was built (passive past). Здание is neuter.
items.explanation: Passive past построенный in dative neuter: построенному (agrees with зданию). Active построившему would mean 'the building that built something,' which is nonsensical.

items.prompt: Он рассказал о людях, _____ ему в трудное время. (who helped him)
items.promptEnglish: He talked about people who helped him during a difficult time.
items.hint: О + prepositional plural. The action is in the past (imperfective). Who performed the action?
items.explanation: Active past imperfective: помогавших (who were helping). Prepositional plural to agree with о людях. Помогающих would be present tense.

minimalPairs.context: Мы нашли документы, _____ в архиве. (found in the archive - passive past)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The documents were found in the archive.
minimalPairs.explanation: The documents were found (passive): обнаруженные. Active обнаружившие would mean 'documents that discovered' (nonsensical).

minimalPairs.context: Учёный, _____ новый метод, получил грант. (who developed - active past)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The scientist who developed the new method received a grant.
minimalPairs.explanation: The scientist developed (active): разработавший. Passive разработанный would describe the method, not the scientist.

minimalPairs.context: Письмо уже _____. (the letter has been written - predicate)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Choose the correct predicative form (stating a result).
minimalPairs.explanation: Predicative (stating result) uses the short form: Письмо написано. Long form написанное is for attributive use (написанное письмо).

sets.title: Build & Correct
sets.description: Construct sentences from words and find and fix participle errors
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения из слов и найдите и исправьте ошибки в причастиях

errorCorrection.sentence: Студент, читающий книгу вчера, сдал экзамен.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The student reading a book yesterday passed the exam. (tense mismatch)
errorCorrection.hint: Present participle with вчера (yesterday) is a tense mismatch.
errorCorrection.explanation: Читающий is present tense but вчера is past. Use the past active participle читавший (who was reading yesterday).

errorCorrection.sentence: Контракт, подписавший директором, вступил в силу.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The contract that signed by the director took effect. (voice error)
errorCorrection.hint: The contract was signed (passive), not signing (active).
errorCorrection.explanation: Подписавший is active (who signed). But the contract was signed by the director (passive). Use passive past: подписанный директором.

errorCorrection.sentence: Люди, живущих в этом районе, жалуются на шум.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: People living in this area complain about noise. (wrong case agreement)
errorCorrection.hint: The participle must agree with люди in case. What case is люди here?
errorCorrection.explanation: Люди is nominative (subject). The participle must also be nominative: живущие (not genitive живущих). Participles agree in gender, number, and case.

errorCorrection.sentence: Вопрос, обсуждающий на совещании, очень важен.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The question discussing at the meeting is very important. (voice error)
errorCorrection.hint: The question is being discussed (passive), not discussing something (active).
errorCorrection.explanation: Обсуждающий is active (discussing). The question is the object of discussion, not the agent. Use passive present: обсуждаемый на совещании.

translation.english: The report prepared by analysts contains important data.
translation.answer: Отчёт, подготовленный аналитиками, содержит важные данные.
acceptableVariants: Подготовленный аналитиками отчёт содержит важные данные.
translation.hint: Use passive past participle from подготовить. Choose attributive or detached position.

translation.english: Students studying abroad often face difficulties.
translation.answer: Студенты, обучающиеся за рубежом, часто сталкиваются с трудностями.
acceptableVariants: Обучающиеся за рубежом студенты часто сталкиваются с трудностями.
translation.hint: Active present participle from обучаться (reflexive). Nominative plural.
translation.grammarFocus: Active present participle with reflexive verb

translation.english: The scientist who discovered this phenomenon received a prize.
translation.answer: Учёный, открывший это явление, получил премию.
acceptableVariants: Открывший это явление учёный получил премию.
translation.hint: Active past participle from открыть. The scientist performed the action.

translation.english: The decision made by the committee will affect everyone.
translation.hint: Passive past from принять. The decision was made by someone.
translation.grammarFocus: Passive past participle with agent (instrumental case)
